text:
nina-people: Heads up 1 - Leah in London asked if she can observe Diwali on Dec 24 even though our year-end blackout is Dec 20Dec 31. Shes part-time (0.6 FTE) and said family travel plans are firm. Manager asked if we can make an exception or allow a swap. Any guidance?

leah-frontend: Manager ping 449 I can do an evening on-call shift on Dec 27 in exchange for Dec 24 off. Would prefer a formal ok so I can book flights.

nina-people: Quick policy recap: blackout means standard PTO approvals are restricted because of coverage, but we do allow documented religious accommodations and essential time-off with People Ops approval. For part-time colleagues we prorate accruals; however Diwali is a single-day request so options are: (A) approve as accommodation (unpaid or paid depending on accrual available), (B) approve a swap (Leah covers on-call shift and gets a comp day), or (C) manager approves unpaid leave and documents it.

ken-ops: Ops note: If Leah covers on-call, we need the swap recorded in pager-duty notes and a CC to ops so we can mark coverage. We don't typically allow last-minute swaps during blackout without People Ops sign-off.

leah-frontend: I have 2.5 days of prorated PTO left. If I use 1 day on Dec 24 will that come out of my allowance or be a religious day? Not sure how we classify.

nina-people: For classification: religious observance is treated as PTO if you have balance, or unpaid if not. For part-time accruals we use FTE factor; payroll will compute. If you propose a swap (cover on-call evening 12/27), we can give a 1 comp-day instead of using PTO. Comp-days for part-time are pro-rated but we can code a full company comp-day and then payroll will prorate pay if needed.

jon-payroll (via DM to nina-people): To process comp-day for part-time: we need a one-line CSV with worker_id and comp_date. Example: ```
worker_id, reason, comp_date, pay_code
67890, "comp for holiday coverage (Diwali swap)", 2026-01-04, COMP-DAY
```
Send to payroll@redwood.com and cc nina-people.

tomas-legal: Quick legal flag: religious accommodation requests must be treated neutrally. Don't require medical proof or excessive burdens. Document the managers approval and People Ops sign-off. If there's any differential treatment vs other employees, escalate to Legal.

nina-people: Plan: manager to confirm swap in email -> ops to acknowledge coverage -> People Ops approves accommodation in HRIS and notifies payroll if comp-day requested. Leah: please confirm in thread so we have written record (works as doc attachment). :thumbsup: 

leah-frontend: Confirmed 44D I will cover 12/27 evening on-call and request Dec 24 off. Manager confirmed by DM.

calendar-bot: Reminder: Year-end blackout 2026-12-20 to 2026-12-31. Exceptions require People Ops + Manager approval.

nina-people: Thanks everyone. I'll file the People Ops ticket and update HRIS once manager 4E-mail is received. Ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-2026.

ken-ops: Noted; I'll update PD notes once the email lands.

leah-frontend: Appreciate it 49A
